scope.process_identity: one retained stdout/stderr pair and one parent receipt per method and repetition
scope.backend_identity: worker-reported package and runtime metadata, checked against the retained environment and dependency pins
scope.output_identity: canonical complete-output byte count and digest, checked against every retained legal-binding profile
limits: The historical worker record does not retain a process identifier or executable binary digest.
The worker reports complete-output comparison; its retained digest binds that report to the expected output, not to an independent execution transcript.
This audit does not execute CUDD, repeat timings, or independently re-prove the semantic correctness of the expected profiles.
